text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: Incident I-1797654321 fired for service=redwood-inference-serving, symptom=queue_depth_spike && p99_latency>2000ms. Triggering policy: rollout_autoscaler_alert. Links: https://telemetry.internal/alerts/1797654321

pagerduty-bot: Incident assigned to @oncall-sre (emma). Escalation timeout 5m. Incident URL: https://pd.redwood/inci/I-1797654321

emma: I'm on it. grabbing logs and checking rollout. any customer-impact notes?

raj: seeing increased 502/504 from edge -> runtime for the last ~3m. Traffic shifted to new variant v12 during the fast rollout.

lin: adding context: autoscaler rapidly increased replicas but observed many short-lived pods with OOMs. suspect memory cliff in v12.

michael: :eyes: telemetry snapshots: p95 tokens/sec dropped, queue depth up to 1800 (baseline 50). CDN retries also spiking.

emma: ok, priority = high. @raj can you pull pod logs for v12? focus on OOM traces and kernel messages.

raj: grabbing logs now. snippet: ```
E0921 03:12:14.234 RuntimeError: allocation failed: requested 4096MB, available 0MB
...
Killed process 1423 (server) signal 9 (OOM)
```

lin: same pattern across nodes us-west-2b-*, lookups show quantized kernel path in v12 increased memory pressure (new attention cache change).

oncall-sre: Suggest immediate traffic diversion back to v11 and pause rollout. Can we flip routing?

emma: yes. Initiating traffic-shift command to control-plane: ```
# shift 100% traffic to v11
redwoodctl rollout traffic --service serving --from v12 --to v11 --percent 100
```

pagerduty-bot: @emma acknowledged incident at 1797654332.

incident-bot: Automation note: started traffic shift at 1797654334. Expected convergence in ~30s.

raj: traffic shift executed, rps to v11 increasing. Confirming: v12 pod count still spinning up but receiving 0 new requests.

michael: latency p99 falling from 2300ms -> 600ms within 45s. Errors dropping. good signal.

lin: we should roll back v12 images in the cluster and mark the release paused. Recommend marking v12 as blocked until root cause known.

emma: Agreed. I'm creating a rollback patch and disabling the rollout pipeline for v12. Command: ```
redwoodctl releases rollback --service serving --image v12 --target v11 --reason "OOM regression after attention cache change"
```

raj: rollback started. I'm collecting full pod core dumps and storing to /artifacts/incidents/1797654321/ for postmortem.

michael: Customer impact: estimated 1.2% of traffic experienced elevated latencies and ~0.4% request failures for 3m window during rollout. No data loss reported. Logging customer-visible error ids to incident ticket.

emma: Good. Notify CS to surface any customer reports. @michael can you draft a short customer-facing blurb?

michael: Draft: "We experienced a short period of increased latency and errors related to a recent model runtime rollout. Traffic has been diverted to the previously healthy version and the rollout has been paused. We're investigating and will follow up with findings and mitigation timeline."

lin: adding diagnostics: heap profiles show v12's attention cache retaining references leading to memory growth proportional to sequence length. Config difference: v11 sets attention_cache_max_entries=8, v12 default=unbounded.

emma: :warning: that's likely root cause. Create a hotfix branch to reintroduce limit and run e2e in staging before redeploy.

raj: filing PR now: https://git.redwood/serving/pulls/4242 - includes attention_cache cap + telemetry guardrails. CI flagged a quirk but tests pass locally.

pagerduty-bot: Incident note: escalation to senior SRE @lin at 1797654352 due to regression in rollout pipeline.

lin: I'll lead postmortem. For mitigation, adding automated rollout abort when pod OOM rate > 5% within 2m and queue_depth>500. Also propose canary headroom floor to prevent fast ramp from hitting autoscaler cliffs.

emma: Agreed. Add blockers: update rollout policy, add canary traffic ramp to 1%, 5%, 20%, 100% with checks.

oncall-sre: Any follow-ups needed for infra? maybe increase node eviction thresholds temporarily?

michael: Not necessary now — traffic shifted and rollback proceeding. We'll monitor for 30m then close incident if stable.

emma: marking incident as mitigated at 1797654360. Will wait 30m for stability window. Adding summary to ticket.

raj: artifacts uploaded: /artifacts/incidents/1797654321/{logs,cores,heapprofiles}.

lin: postmortem owner=lin, severity=sev2, timeline start=1797654321, mitigated=1797654360. Will schedule blameless review and link follow-up tasks (rollout policy, telemetry guards, canary ramp).

michael: pinging CS: @support-team please watch for customer tickets referencing increased latency between 03:12-03:16 UTC and escalate if needed.

pagerduty-bot: Incident I-1797654321 resolved by @emma at 1797654365. Please leave a resolution note.

emma: resolution note: "Rollback v12 and traffic diversion to v11 mitigated regressions caused by attention cache unbounded growth. Follow-ups: PR 4242 (heatfix), rollout policy changes, telemetry alert tuning." :white_check_mark:

lin: Thanks team. I'll open the postmortem draft and assign action items. Closing thread after stability window. :wave:
